title: IBM Quantum Learning course catalog
description: IBM's free catalog of 15 self-paced courses, from first circuits on real hardware to variational algorithms, quantum machine learning and utility-scale experiments.
free_note: free to read; optional badges via exams at IBM Training

title: Basics of Quantum Information
description: First course of Watrous's series covering classical and quantum single and multiple systems, quantum circuits and entanglement, for newcomers comfortable with linear algebra.
free_note: free to read; optional badge exam

title: Fundamentals of Quantum Algorithms
description: Second course of the Watrous series on query algorithms, phase estimation, factoring and Grover search, for learners who finished the basics course.
free_note: free to read; optional badge exam

title: General Formulation of Quantum Information
description: Third course of the Watrous series on density matrices, quantum channels and general measurements, the formalism needed to describe noise.
free_note: free to read; optional badge exam

title: Foundations of Quantum Error Correction
description: Fourth course of the Watrous series covering stabilizer and CSS codes, the toric and surface codes, and fault-tolerant computation.
free_note: free to read; optional badge exam

title: Understanding Quantum Information & Computation with John Watrous (video series)
description: Free graduate-level video lecture series (18 videos) that accompanies IBM's four Watrous courses, each lecture paired with a written companion.

title: Quantum Computing in Practice
description: Course on realistic use cases and best practices for running experiments on today's 100-plus-qubit processors, for learners who know basic circuits.
free_note: free to read; optional badge exam

title: Utility-Scale Quantum Computing
provider: IBM Quantum with the University of Tokyo
description: Fourteen lessons with labs, developed with the University of Tokyo, building up to a utility-scale calculation like IBM's 2023 Nature experiment.
free_note: free to read

title: Qiskit tutorials
description: Hands-on Qiskit notebooks from a CHSH starter to Hamiltonian diagonalization, error mitigation, dynamic circuits, Shor and Grover, for programmers.
free_note: free to read; running on IBM hardware requires an IBM Quantum account

title: Qiskit YouTube channel
description: IBM's official Qiskit channel with lectures, coding tutorials, summer-school recordings and community updates for all levels.

title: Qiskit Textbook (archived source)
description: Source notebooks of the classic open Qiskit Textbook covering circuits, algorithms and applications; archived in January 2024 and superseded by IBM Quantum Learning.
free_note: free (Apache-2.0); archived and no longer maintained

title: Quantum Country
description: Free online book with built-in spaced-repetition review covering quantum computing, search, teleportation and quantum mechanics, for readers who know basic linear algebra.

title: Quirk
description: Open-source drag-and-drop browser simulator for small circuits with live state displays and examples like Grover search and teleportation.

title: Xanadu Quantum Codebook
description: Fifteen modules of guided coding exercises from single-qubit gates through Grover, QFT, phase estimation, Shor and error correction.
free_note: free; signing in saves progress

title: PennyLane demos
description: Large library of open-source PennyLane tutorials on algorithms, quantum machine learning, chemistry, compilation and fault-tolerant resource estimation.

title: Quantum Katas (QDK Learning)
description: Self-paced lessons with theory and Q# exercises, now run inside the free Quantum Development Kit extension for VS Code.
free_note: free; needs VS Code and the free QDK extension; Copilot features optional

title: Get started with Azure Quantum (learning path)
description: Six-module path introducing quantum computing, first Q# programs, superposition, teleportation and resource estimation.
free_note: free; running jobs on Azure Quantum hardware is billed

title: Quantum Computing for Computer Scientists
description: Classic talk explaining qubits, gates and the Deutsch oracle problem from a computer-science perspective, assuming only basic linear algebra.

title: Cirq tutorials and experiments
description: Cirq notebooks covering textbook algorithms, Shor, VQE, QAOA and reproductions of Google experiments such as surface-code memory and random circuit sampling.

title: Hands-on quantum error correction with Google Quantum AI
description: Introductory course on error correction with hands-on work in Stim and Crumble, for first-year undergraduates through researchers.
free_note: free to enroll per Google Quantum AI; Coursera certificate costs extra

title: Google Quantum AI YouTube channel
description: Google's official channel with lab tours, explainers, Cirq how-tos and talks on its error-correction results.

title: Amazon Braket example notebooks
description: Official notebooks for Braket covering algorithms, hybrid jobs, noise simulation, pulse control, analog Hamiltonian simulation and QPUs from several vendors.
free_note: notebooks free (Apache-2.0); running on Braket simulators or QPUs is billed by AWS

title: CUDA-Q documentation, examples and applications
description: Official CUDA-Q docs with examples on kernels, GPU and multi-GPU simulation, noise, dynamics, and applications like Shor and Krylov diagonalization.

title: CUDA-Q Academic
description: Free self-paced Jupyter modules from a zero-background quick start to QEC 101, QAOA and chemistry, built to supplement university courses.
free_note: free for educational use (Apache-2.0 / CC-BY-NC-4.0)

title: Classiq documentation and tutorials
description: Getting-started, onboarding tutorial, user guide and algorithm library for Classiq's high-level Qmod language.
free_note: docs free to read

title: pytket user guide and examples
description: Quantinuum's guide to the open-source tket compiler: building circuits, compilation passes, routing and running on backends.

title: Guppy language guide and examples
description: Docs for Guppy, a Python-embedded quantum language, with a browser playground and examples on magic-state distillation and fault-tolerant programs.

title: Quantum Computation (18.435J)
description: Graduate course by Peter Shor with lecture notes, problem sets and exams with solutions.

title: Quantum Complexity Theory (6.845)
description: Graduate course on quantum complexity classes, query complexity and related theory, with lecture notes and problem sets.

title: Quantum Information Science I (8.370x)
provider: MIT OpenCourseWare / MIT Open Learning Library
description: Three-part MITx course on qubits, circuits, algorithms and protocols, archived for free self-study on the Open Learning Library.
free_note: free via MIT Open Learning Library; no enrollment needed to view

title: Quantum Information Science II (8.371x)
provider: MIT OpenCourseWare / MIT Open Learning Library
description: Follow-on MITx course covering error correction, fault tolerance, quantum complexity and quantum information theory.
free_note: free via MIT Open Learning Library

title: Ph219/CS219 Quantum Computation lecture notes
description: Preskill's classic notes covering foundations, entanglement, circuits, algorithms, error correction, topological computing and quantum Shannon theory.

title: Quantum Computing: Lecture Notes
provider: arXiv (QuSoft / CWI and University of Amsterdam)
description: Widely used undergraduate-to-master's notes on circuits, Fourier-based and search algorithms, query and communication complexity, and error correction.

title: Lecture Notes on Quantum Algorithms
description: Graduate notes on circuit synthesis, hidden subgroup problems, quantum walks, query complexity, Hamiltonian simulation and adiabatic computing.

title: Introduction to Quantum Information Science lecture notes
description: Aaronson's undergraduate course notes, an informal and rigorous tour from qubits to algorithms, error correction and quantum supremacy.

title: PHYS771: Quantum Computing Since Democritus lecture notes
description: Twenty-one free lecture notes connecting computation, complexity and quantum mechanics, the basis of Aaronson's later book.

title: The Theory of Quantum Information
provider: University of Waterloo / Cambridge University Press
description: Rigorous graduate textbook on the mathematical theory of quantum states, channels, entropy and entanglement.
free_note: free manuscript PDF for personal use; print edition sold by Cambridge University Press

title: From Classical to Quantum Shannon Theory
description: Graduate book on quantum Shannon theory, channel capacities and entropy, posted free on arXiv.
free_note: free arXiv version; print edition sold separately

title: Introduction to Quantum Information Science (qubit.guide)
provider: Artur Ekert et al. (University of Oxford / CQT Singapore)
description: Free online introductory textbook from Oxford lecture courses, a work in progress covering qubits, interference, entanglement, algorithms and error correction.

title: Surviving as a Quantum Computer in a Classical World (draft textbook)
description: Gottesman's draft graduate textbook on quantum error correction and fault tolerance, posted free alongside his UMD course.
free_note: free draft PDF

title: Lecture Notes on Quantum Algorithms for Scientific Computation
description: Graduate notes on phase estimation, Hamiltonian simulation, block encodings, QSP/QSVT and linear-system solvers.

title: Quantum Computing for the Quantum Curious
description: Short open-access textbook for high-school and early undergraduate readers introducing qubits, gates and simple algorithms.
free_note: open access

title: Understanding Quantum Technologies
description: Over-1,000-page free survey by a French analyst of the science, hardware, software, vendors and history of quantum technologies.
free_note: free arXiv edition (5th ed., 2022); newer editions are on the author's site

title: Introduction to Quantum Information Processing (QIC 710) video lectures
provider: Institute for Quantum Computing, University of Waterloo
description: Twenty-two recorded lectures from a beginner primer through algorithms, information theory and BB84, for advanced undergraduates and graduate students.
free_note: public YouTube videos

title: Fundamentals of Quantum Information
description: QuTech's open course on working with single and multiple qubits, quantum compiling, quantum dots and the state of the field.
free_note: CC BY-NC-SA 4.0

title: QuTube: The School of Quantum
description: QuTech's video learning platform from Quantum 101 to quantum computer and internet hardware, algorithms and advanced theory.

title: Quantum Computation (CS294) course notes
description: Vazirani's graduate course page with lecture notes, including those from his Berkeley edX course on quantum mechanics and computation.

title: CS 269Q: Elements of Quantum Computer Programming
description: Free lecture slides and section notes from Stanford's quantum programming course, with guest lectures from Rigetti and Xanadu.

title: 15-859BB: Quantum Computation and Quantum Information
description: Full graduate course with 25-plus recorded lectures, PDF notes and homework, from one qubit to query complexity and quantum supremacy.
free_note: public YouTube videos

title: Quantum Information (PSI elective, PHYS 635) lectures
description: Recorded Perimeter Scholars International lectures on quantum information in PIRSA, Perimeter's free video archive.

title: Quantum Error Correction and Fault Tolerance (QIC 890) lectures
description: Graduate QEC course page linking each lecture recording on PIRSA, covering stabilizer codes, fault tolerance and thresholds.
free_note: recordings free on PIRSA

title: Quantum Summer Cluster Workshop videos
provider: Simons Institute for the Theory of Computing
description: Research talks on verifiable quantum advantage, Gibbs sampling and quantum PCPs, for graduate students and researchers.

title: Quantum Computing for the Determined
description: Twenty-two short videos by the co-author of Nielsen and Chuang, covering the basic model, entanglement, superdense coding and teleportation.

title: Quantum Native Dojo
description: Japanese self-study course of Colab notebooks from qubit basics to VQE, quantum chemistry, phase estimation and error correction.
free_note: online version free; a print edition is sold

title: Quantum Information lecture notes (University of Tokyo summer course)
description: Sixteen Japanese lecture-note PDFs on quantum information plus a book-length text on noise processes, spin qubits and fault tolerance.

title: MindSpore Quantum tutorials
description: Chinese tutorials from parameterized circuits and noise simulation to Grover, Shor, HHL, QAOA, VQE and quantum neural networks.

title: Principles and Applications of Quantum Information (量子信息原理与应用)
description: Chinese MOOC on quantum mechanics for qubits, density operators, entanglement, quantum communication, cryptography and algorithms.
free_note: page does not state cost; optional paid certification mentioned

title: TensorCircuit-NG tutorials
description: About 30 notebooks for the open-source TensorCircuit-NG framework (successor to Tencent's TensorCircuit) on QAOA, VQE, QML, shadows and distributed simulation.

title: PyQuafu user guide
provider: Beijing Academy of Quantum Information Sciences (Quafu cloud)
description: Guide to building circuits and running them on BAQIS's superconducting chips through the Quafu cloud, including a T1 decoherence example.
free_note: guide free; a Quafu API token is needed to run on hardware

title: pyQPanda tutorial
description: Tutorial for Origin Quantum's pyQPanda SDK covering circuits, compilation, variational circuits and algorithms from QFT to HHL, Grover and Shor.

title: Introduction to Quantum Computing: Quantum Algorithms and Qiskit
description: Indian NPTEL course combining quantum algorithm theory with Qiskit practice, for undergraduates and engineers.
free_note: free to watch; optional NPTEL certification exam has a fee

title: IQM Academy
description: Free tutorials in beginner, intermediate and advanced tracks, from qubit foundations to textbook algorithms, error detection and decoding.

title: Bronze: Basics of Quantum Computing
description: Open Jupyter notebooks from QWorld, used in its worldwide QBronze workshops, introducing qubits, entanglement and Grover search with Qiskit.
free_note: free public repository

title: A practical introduction to quantum computing: from qubits to quantum machine learning and beyond
provider: CERN Quantum Technology Initiative / CERN openlab
description: Seven-lecture CERN series by a University of Oviedo professor with slides, Qiskit notebooks and recordings.

title: Quantum Autumn School 2024 materials
description: Nordic school notebooks on HPC-quantum integration, VQE/QAOA, CSS codes, surface-code thresholds and applications.
free_note: CC-BY-4.0 material, MIT-licensed code

title: Quantum Inspire
description: QuTech's cloud platform with a knowledge base and free access to superconducting, spin and neutral-atom backends.
free_note: free registration

title: Technion quantum online courses
description: Technion's YouTube course playlists, several in Hebrew, on quantum technologies for engineers, noisy quantum computing and quantum information.
free_note: public YouTube playlists

title: Introduction to Quantum Information
description: Korean university's beginning-graduate course on quantum states, no-go theorems and algorithms such as Deutsch, with subtitles in many languages.
free_note: Coursera says 'enroll for free' but free audit was not confirmed

title: QuTiP tutorials and lectures
description: Notebooks for the open-source QuTiP toolbox on open-system dynamics, optimal control, tomography and circuit QED.

title: Pulser tutorials
description: Tutorials for Pasqal's open-source Pulser library on designing pulse sequences for neutral-atom arrays, from registers to QUBO solving.
free_note: open source (Apache-2.0)
